description: Codex / Codex-plugin tool bindings for adhoc-sdlc prompt templates. Codex names no dedicated question/subagent tool in its prose (speak in actions), so ASK renders as a descriptive phrase and the subagent via-clause is empty. SKILL_VIA renders `$<name>` after the only evidence in the repo (`$cove` in skills/cove/agents/openai.yaml); the plugin-skill invocation syntax is not yet confirmed. Paths resolve against the installed skill dir (<skill-dir>). Output tree is the Codex plugin: plugins/adhoc-sdlc/.

placeholders.ASK_NOTE: Use a native choice UI when the surface provides one, otherwise plain numbered options; do not imply that the plugin provides its own custom form UI.
placeholders.SKILL_HOME_NOTE: When command docs show `<skill-dir>`, resolve it to the directory containing this `SKILL.md` and `reference.md`; do not hard-code `~/.codex/skills/adhoc-sdlc` when the skill came from a Codex plugin install.
placeholders.REPORT_DELIVERY:
On demand, deliver the report as a Markdown file:

1. Write it to the location the user gives, or the project's convention, otherwise `research/cleanup-<scope>-<YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM>.md`.
2. Choose a name that does not overwrite an existing report.
3. Write the full report to the file. The request to use the skill authorizes writing this file without a separate question.
4. Reply with a clickable link to the file that actually exists and a short summary of the result; do not repeat the tables in the chat by default.
5. Say that the file is untracked and do not add it to git.
6. When writing is not possible, report the reason; never claim a file that does not exist.

The operator reviews the items in that file (confirm, reject, or discuss each ID); their decisions and notes are the input of `/adhoc-sdlc:plan --from-report`.
